note: Gunnison NF (Gunnison RD) campground north of Blue Mesa Reservoir, ~7,700 ft: from US-50 take CO-92 1 mi, Forest Road 721 7.25 mi, then FR 824 0.5 mi. Coal Mesa Trailhead on site gives access to the southern West Elk Wilderness. Soap Creek runs through woods east of the loop. --Claude
